description: Start connecting a website to Tusk in one step. Give the site's human `name` and its live `domain`; this returns a single link. Show the person that link: they open it, sign in to Tusk, and press Approve — which BOTH adds the site to their studio AND connects this assistant to it. Then call finish_connect to complete (it waits for the approval and reports when the site is live). Use this the first time there is no token (a 401 from other tools), or whenever the person wants to add a new site. It creates nothing on the web and touches no code or hosting.

domain.description: The live hostname, e.g. "northstudio.com.au". Strongly recommended: it names the site and seeds the slug.

name.description: The site's human name, e.g. "North Studio".

previewUrl.description: An https URL Tusk can fetch to scan/preview now (the live site, or a preview deployment).

startEmpty.description: Default true: the site starts with no demo fields, so the first scan of your marks is all the client sees. Pass false only for Tusk's worked-example starter content.

name: connect_site
title: Connect a site
